يقتعدوا (form VIII)
# يَقْتَعِدُوا (yaqtaʕidū) /jaq.ta.ʕi.duː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَعَدَ (iqtaʕada)
# يُقْتَعَدُوا (yuqtaʕadū) /juq.ta.ʕa.duː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَعَدَ (iqtaʕada)
